doc: A Sample-capable plugin (the aarch64 zip) installed with its own install.sh onto the SD card: files, MPC Sample.settings,
findings: install.sh without -t tries /sdcard/Synths, which is on the Sample's read-only root, and stops (error: cannot create /sdcard/Synths); the SD card is never tried: on a Sample -t /media/MPCSD/Synths is needed
